comment: Human-reviewed license exceptions for the licenses gate (tools/check-licenses.mjs). Each entry is {"package": string, "reason": string} — the package is allowlisted by name even when its license is outside the permissive allowlist. Adding an entry is a human decision (this file is write-guard-protected); the gate fails LOUD on any malformed entry, never open.

exceptions.reason: libvips ships LGPL-3.0-or-later; sharp (next@16 image optimization) links it dynamically as an OPTIONAL, os/cpu-gated platform binary — only the current platform's variant installs. Dynamic LGPL linkage imposes no source obligation on this codebase; the binary is unmodified and separately replaceable. Covers the darwin/linux variants the validate lanes actually install (dev macOS + CI ubuntu).
See @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 — the Intel-macOS variant of the same LGPL-3.0 libvips binary pulled by next@16's sharp.
See @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 — the linux-x64 variant installed on the CI (ubuntu) validate lane.
See @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 — the linux-arm64 variant for arm CI runners.
